name: nTSGenetics::cTSSimDNA::Create
notes: Factory, not a thiscall constructor: cdecl allocation of 12 bytes; vtable 0xdce3f0, refcount +4, retained property store +8. EHs, one state, no try blocks. Differential test passed 400 cases: 100 seeded allocations, 100 injected null allocations, 200 real CRT allocations. Mutants killed (3): allocation size +4, initial refcount 1, property store set to self. Coordinator smoke test pending. Full suite: 2452 tests, only existing TreeSim_ReplayMapFree failed; all five SimDNA tests passed after source restoration. Standalone shape (lane EE): `return new cTSSimDNA;` (our constructor, our vtable): the class's only creation site (address stored by the cTSSimCOMDirector constructor 0x415ae0), so this hook is the class's switch. The difftest compares the object with its vtable word normalised (the side's own vtable).

name: nTSGenetics::cTSSimDNA::DeletingDestructor
notes: EHs noexcept; installs vtable, releases retained +8 pointer without clearing it, optionally sized-deletes twelve bytes for flags&1, returns this. Differential test passed 512 cases over all flag bytes and null/non-null store: 256 retained, 256 freed. Whole object and canaries for retained objects; object snapshot and allocation size at delete, immediate HeapValidate checks for freed objects, exact fake release sequence and state. Mutants killed (3): omitted vtable installation, omitted store Release, deletion flag bit 2 instead of bit 1. Coordinator smoke test pending. Full suite: 2452 tests, only existing TreeSim_ReplayMapFree failed; all five SimDNA tests passed after source restoration. Standalone shape (lane EE): our vtable's slot 17 is the compiler's scalar deleting destructor (~cTSSimDNA releases the store); the hook is a hand-written adapter (destructor, then sized delete on bit 0; stores our vtable into a game-built object). The difftest calls slot 17 of our vtable; SimDNA_Adapters the adapter (flags 0 and 1). matchcheck 0.931 (lane EE): the adapter stores our vtable after loading the store where the original stores it first (scheduling); a hand-written adapter gets no vtable tie. In effect through its callers (lane GJ): the adapter and its hook are gone; only the game's vtable slots reference the original, and no object carries those vtables while the hook SimDNA_Create is in, so the host traps the original under that switch.

name: nTSGenetics::DNAVector<DNAWeightedGene>::InsertReallocate
notes: Ret 8, returns inserted record pointer. Actual class is a three-pointer allocator-service vector of 68-byte records (two cRZStrings plus signed weight). Allocates max(size+1,capacity+capacity/2), saturating at 0x3c3c3c3; copies inserted record first to support aliased input, then old prefix/suffix, destroys old records and frees old storage. On copy failure destroys completed range before inserted record and frees new block. Uses verified GetAllocatorService/FreeThroughAllocatorService and native CRT thread-static helpers and std::_Xlength_error, never original library code. 1000 direct cases: append/interior 785/215, alias 166, first allocator use 200, injected allocation/copy failures 142. Full vector capacity/heap/call comparisons. CRT epoch ids are normalized to unset/pending/initialized state because the two CRT instances own separate counters. Five mutants killed: capacity growth factor, insertion offset, lost scalar, leaked old storage, omitted exception record cleanup. Coordinator smoke test pending.
